text:
monica: Quick heads-up — kicking off a v2 canary in us-west tomorrow 10:30 PST. low traffic slice, want owners on-call for first 2 hours. pinging owners for dependency checks.
noah: I can own the python SDK shim for backwards compat. will send PR today (keeping runtime fallback for two releases).
jia: @noah please include an e2e that verifies header passthrough + user-agent preservation. last time we saw flakiness there.
noah: yep — adding tests and a small migration note in the README. PR link when ready.
sarah: telemetry owner here — I'll emit a new metric api.v2.request_origin and span attribute compat.variant. created INF-312 to track dashboard work.
mike: infra note: gateway will enable fallback routing to v1 for 24h by default. we need a clear mapping strategy for payload shapes — who owns that mapping table?
olivia: platform will take mapping ownership (platforms/schema-mapper). I'll open a mapping PR and a short migration script tomorrow.
monica: any outstanding breaking changes to public callsites we should flag to SDKs / customers?
noah: minor param rename in python: stream -> enable_stream to avoid future ambiguity. shim will keep old name supported with a deprecation warning for two releases.
jia: canary success criteria? need exact numbers for the runbook.
monica: agreed — primary checks: error rate <= 0.5% (token-level errors), 95th latency < 150ms, no data-loss traces; telemetry spike or new regression => rollback. rollback must be possible within 30m.
olivia: I'll create a console toggle under deploy/v2-canary/us-west-1 and set @olivia as owner.
mike: infra will monitor qps and autoscale; if traffic > 120% baseline we'll throttle new sessions and alert on backlog.
sarah: dashboard link (draft): http://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/inf/v2-canary — added panels for errors, latency, variant distribution.
deploy-bot: canary started: deploy/v2-canary/us-west-1 at 2025-03-10T10:30:12Z (canary id: c-20250310-42).
noah: PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/8472 — includes shim + tests. tagging @jia for e2e review.
monica: thanks all. please add short status to the canary doc after you do your item: https://docs.redwood.dev/canary/v2 — async updates ok. ping in thread if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
